hint.offline: Check your connection and try again.

hint.pushInvalid: Turn push off and on again.
hint.permission: Allow notifications in the browser's site settings, then try again.
hint.pushService: Try again later; private windows and browsers with push disabled can't subscribe.
hint.unsupported: Use a browser that supports Web Push; on iPhone or iPad, add Oryn to the Home Screen first.
hint.unknown: Try again later; if it keeps failing, open the details.

hint.rejected: Check the token, key, or headers, then test again.
hint.notFound: Check the URL, topic, or device key.
hint.rateLimited: Wait a moment, then test again.

hint.timeout: Make sure the orynd host can reach this address, then test again.
hint.unreachable: Check the address for typos and the orynd host's network and DNS.
hint.tls: Make sure the address uses a valid HTTPS certificate; self-signed certificates aren't trusted.
hint.unknown: Open the details to see why, fix the settings, then test again.
